objects.name: Analytic 1741
objects.description: For Android, detect Command and Scripting Interpreter from documented management, network, or vetting evidence; treat state queries as periodic observations rather than real-time events. Correlate Command Execution via Application Vetting / Instrumented Dynamic Analysis [Dynamic API/runtime trace: App spawns sh, bash, toybox, toolbox, or su child process with command arguments within $ShellActivityWindow$ of shell launch — child shell process with arguments is the script execution signal]; Process Creation via Application Vetting / Managed Device Telemetry [App invokes Runtime.exec(), ProcessBuilder.start(), or JNI-backed command execution framework to spawn shell or command interpreter process NOT IN $ApprovedShellApps$ — programmatic shell spawn is the interpreter invocation]. Alert on a sequence or state change inconsistent with the device/app baseline, approved management policy, or expected user workflow; do not infer unobserved API calls, file/process activity, or payload content from management state alone.

x_mitre_mutable_elements.description: Terminal emulator apps (on non-production developer devices only), ADB-connected sessions. Production fleet: empty — no app should spawn shells. Derive from IT device classification.
Default 30s between shell spawn and follow-on file/network activity. Shell execution and follow-on activity are near-synchronous.
